_note: English retranslation of the Japanese script, from the 'Akumajou Dracula X: Gekka no Yasoukyoku' translation patch v1.0 (2009) by Gemini (hacking), throughhim413 (translation) and Tom (editing); used with throughhim413's permission (2026-11). Keys: the Japanese disc's voice ids (PS1 US id - 2, as the PSP's). Each line: its boxes as the patch shows them (\n = its line break). Shown with the Japanese dub (tools/psp_script.py).
